description: Designed for code change review, with support for Git, SVN, and unmanaged projects,check off each file as reviewed, and enter a diff review mode (editable, accept, reject).
view.name: Local Changes Review
welcome.noVcs:
This project is not under git / svn.
Initialize a baseline to start reviewing local files like git changes.
[Initialize Baseline](command:changeReview.initBaseline)

Add build artifacts to the [exclude rules](command:changeReview.configureExclude) so they don't pollute the list.
cfg.includeUntracked: Whether to include untracked new files in the review list.
cfg.sortReviewedLast: Place reviewed files at the bottom of the list.
cfg.autoRefreshInterval: Auto-refresh interval in seconds. 0 disables auto refresh.
cfg.contextLines: Number of context lines shown in the diff.
cfg.showStatusBar: Show review progress badge in the status bar.
cfg.gitPath: Full path to the git executable. Leave empty for auto-detect (Windows tries PATH / Program Files\Git\…; Linux/macOS tries /usr/bin/git / /usr/local/bin/git / /opt/homebrew/bin/git). On WSL, if you accidentally picked up the Windows git, set this to /usr/bin/git.
cfg.svnPath: Full path to the svn executable. Leave empty for auto-detect (Windows: PATH / TortoiseSVN / SlikSvn; Linux/macOS: /usr/bin/svn).
cfg.forceVcs: Force a specific VCS. `auto` tries git → svn → snapshot; `git`/`svn` restrict to that one; `snapshot` ignores git/svn and always uses snapshot baseline.
cfg.vcsSearchDepth: How many parent directories to walk up looking for .svn / .git (max 5).
cfg.exclude:
Files to manually exclude. Applies to all kinds across git / svn / snapshot.
Preferred way: run "Configure Exclude Rules…"to edit the project's `.crignore` file — no need to touch these settings.
You may also add globs here directly. Examples: `build/**`, `node_modules/**`, `*.tmp`.
cfg.snapshotExclude: Files to exclude in snapshot baseline mode.
cfg.snapshotMaxFileSize: In snapshot mode, files larger than this (KB) only track changes without saving baseline content (no per-line diff).
cfg.snapshotMaxFiles: Maximum number of files tracked in snapshot baseline mode.
cfg.uiLanguage: Panel UI language: auto follows VSCode display language, zh forces Chinese, en forces English
